Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried out on a monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the above title block.
The function of the gate shaft water level 
indicator is to show the level of water inside the gate shaft.
The first draft 
was initiated and tested by eng. Kamal Amin Gad Allah, accepted by general 
director eng. Atty Sefen Rizk Allah, 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abdel-Baset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety 
Precautions
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area are required
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Tools and 
Equipment
Work to be Carried out

would hinder the float motion.
